props.name: children
props.description: The label. Plain text reads best; the sweep is painted across every glyph.

props.name: tone
props.description: `ink` sweeps a darker band across soft ink; `accent` sweeps the accent across it.

props.name: speed
props.description: Seconds for one sweep across the text.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stop the sweep and show the text plainly — when the work it labels is finished.

props.name: as
props.description: Render as another element — a `p`, a heading.
